title: Projection fixes coordinate-dependent functions
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\pi$, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. If $f:\Omega^n\to\mathbb{R}$ depends only on the coordinates in $J$, then its coordinate projection $P_Jf$, formed by averaging over the other coordinates under the product distribution induced by $\pi$, equals $f$.
